headline: Services Sector Shows Largest Decline in 4 Years and 5 Months; Equipment Investment Including Semiconductors Up 7.5%
summary: July industrial output stayed flat despite strong exports, while services recorded their largest decline in four years and five months. Automobile output fell amid the Hyundai Motor strike.
why: Industrial and services output data are key gauges of South Korea's economic momentum, which affects the won, local equities and export-linked companies.

impacts.name: Hyundai Motor
impacts.why: Automobile output fell due to the Hyundai Motor strike, as stated in the release.
